{{Quote|I must get my father to Mount Krisklar immediately, where skingles may eat out his heart, eyes, and liver in respectful fashion.|Kharys|<ref name="Skyewalkers" />}}
'''Mount Krisklar''' was one of the many [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Marat system/Legends|Marat system]]. In the [[S'kytri mythology|mythology]] of Skye's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], the [[S'kytri]], that mountain was considered a [[Deity/Legends|goddess]]. The myths said that the chief god known as the [[Great Wind]] once [[Reproduction/Legends|mated]] with the goddess Krisklar, siring the S'kytri species itself. When a S'kytri [[Death/Legends|died]], his or her body was brought to Mount Krisklar for excarnation by flying [[skingle]]s. During the [[Battle of Skye]]<ref name="Skyewalkers" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a number of mortally wounded S'kytri attempted to make for Mount Krisklar before breathing their last.
